title: The 'Add Customer' button in the New Work Order flow when Customers Create & Edit is OFF
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders Create & Edit ON, Customers View ON and Customers Create & Edit OFF.
steps:
1. Log in and click New Work Order.
  2. Go to the customer selection step.
  3. Look for an Add Customer button in the customer picker.
expected:
The Add Customer button IS shown in the customer picker, and creating a new customer from the New Work Order flow works.

Adding a customer here is part of creating a work order, so it is available to anyone who can create a work order (Work Orders: Create & Edit). It does NOT require Customers: Create & Edit — it works even if Customers: View is OFF. The Customers permission only controls the Customers area in the top navigation.
